fix(codeon): seal live-e2e reports on every nonzero exit

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-1
  description: |-
    The live wrapper left report.json as result=running whenever cargo failed for a non-timeout reason, so compile errors, panics, and harness failures could drop recovery classification after external artifacts existed. Seal every nonzero wrapper exit (and INT/TERM traps) while preserving already-terminal finalizer output and any persisted database or branch authority.
